reviews.title: Use “Health Sync by appyhapps” instead
reviews.text: I used to use this app around 2018-2019 and worked perfectly. I believe I also had paid a small one time fee to continue using the app after a trial period. I recently downloaded this app (July 2026) and it requires a yearly annual subscription or one time payment to use forever for like $35-$49.99 and I’m not paying that much for something that may not work. You can use it to sync steps only, and not weight and weight metrics which I what I was specifically looking for. I found another app that’s called “Health Sync” which in the App Store shows up as “Health Sync by appyhapps” and this works perfectly so far. There is a 7 day free trial and then a ONE TIME FEE OF $3.99. That’s how this app used to be set up. I suggest trying the Health Sync app rather than this one.

reviews.title: App Struggles Since FitBit became Google Health
reviews.text:
I really appreciated this app when I first utilized it…so much so that I purchased the lifetime subscription 

Unfortunately, I did not realize that my FitBit App…although being utilized on an iPhone….would soon become Google Health. I am very fortunate if I am credited with 1/2 my steps in Apple Health after synching my data from my Fitbit to Apple Health with this App

I need to find something that accurately reflects the steps I take, and since the Fitbit App was renamed to Google Health…This  app is rather disappointing. I understand it is not to developers fault, but had I known Fitbit was changing their App and this app would not synch well with Google Health…I’d have never purchased this app.  It was not worth what I paid for it for the brief time it was fully integrated 

Maybe it’s time I give up my FitBit and adopt an Apple Watch. At least it synchs with Apple Health ☹️
